_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (gym/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: Procedurally generated levels without an upper bound; the first five are listed. An episode is one level, and ends on a win or a loss; reset() restarts the same level. Blocking, as the game is: each block is its level played until cleared (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a loss restarts the same level, so the levels run back to back at the subject's own pace, and max_duration 120 s is the cap on a level nobody clears.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the game's keys, in aigamestore_gym.GAME_KEYS order -- game7: 0=LEFT, 1=RIGHT, 2=UP, 3=DOWN, 4=Z, 5=SPACE, 6=LSHIFT, 7=1, 8=2, 9=3, 10=4, 11=5 -- so 'keys' values are those indices (the JSON key is what the subject presses) and held keys combine. The env relabels the on-canvas hints to the pressed key; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: then reach extraction before time runs out.
Y / LT / RT / A+B / A+X   switch to weapon 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5
